Otherwise it resolves an object through f_700181a6bc, uses f_700183f6e4 if the object field at +0x30 is null, calls player_attribute_get_float with selector 5, converts the float to a signed integer under FPCR, and stores it at output+0: decompiled/main/main_0124.c:29016-29044. No indexed caller is listed.

Initializes the output at x0 to zero, then reads a global context value at 0x700227f620+0x26584 and returns unchanged unless bit 28 is set. Creates a null local result slot and calls f_7000cf3e84 with it and the incoming x1-x3 values. If the helper result has bit 0 set, it passes the returned object plus the saved x1-x3 values to f_7000cf46f4. It then always calls the accepted initialize_season_record_detail_container helper on the original x0 and returns zero: decompiled/main/main_0088.c:40184-40205. The optional helper semantics are unresolved; no indexed caller is listed.

When the second argument is at least 1, reads attribute-context status selector 0x13. It writes uint16 0x0d06 to output+0x98 only when the first status equals 4 (otherwise writes zero), reads selector 0x13 again, writes uint16 zero at output+0x9b, and writes byte 6 at output+0x9a when the second status is zero or byte 1 otherwise. If the second argument is below 1, it makes no output writes: decompiled/main/main_0085.c:19850-19869. No indexed caller is listed.
